segments.source: A Canadian Indian says he saw, one evening, on the road, a white bull with fire streaming from its nostrils, which, after it had passed him, he pursued.
He had never seen so large a bull, or in fact any white bull, upon the reservation.
As it passed in front of a house it was transformed into a man with a large white blanket, who was ever afterward known as a witch.
